===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Intel XScale]] IXP420BB @266MHz ARM *Storage: 16MB Flash, 1x 160GB IDE HDD *Memory: 64MB SDRAM *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet port *WLAN: 802.11bg Atheros 5K *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V/5A via barrel
